intro: From 12 articles published between April 12 and April 30, 2026, ZCyberNews coverage of open-source issues highlights two critical vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-25874 with a CVSS score of 9.3 and CVE-2026-33626 with a CVSS score of 7.5. The reporting spans technology, research, financial services, and software development sectors globally, with a severity mix of five informational, three critical, one high, and two medium alerts.
